some sources indicate it is a version mixup - any idea how to further analyze this issue or even fix it?
answer:
You shouldn't (have to) specify dependencies (commons-io-2.11.0.jar, xmlschema-core-2.3.0.jar, ...) of the libraries (spark-xml_2.12-0.18.0.jar) you're trying to use, unless you're doing something very custom. My Spark installation in example below is inside a poetry virtual env. You can do the same with virtualenv/conda etc. Here are official instructions for conda. If you're on Windows then you'll also need winutils and hadoop.dll.

Using virtualenv is the best way (IMO) to avoid version clashes. Especially useful for local/dev env on your own laptop.

As you can see it installs spark-xml and all it's dependencies automatically. If you're creating SparkSession in code then you can use .config('spark.jars.packages', 'com.databricks:spark-xml_2.12:0.18.0').
